★Request
Display Biko Pegasus (Summer Tracksuit)

■Direction
1 second silence at start

■Direction
SFX: Footsteps

Come cheer for me again if you'd like!
Shake hands with me at the training track! Yeah!
...Must be nice...

If she had a trainer to nurture those qualities,
she might even be able to switch to turf—and yet.

Sure, I'm good on dirt.
I've got decent power, and I don't hate the sand... but, well...

Being a Trainer at Tracen Academy is quite demanding.
Even more so for a freshly appointed newcomer.
Mgh... Gnnn...!

...Turf, huh... Wait, no, no, no!
What're you thinking, Justice Biko?!

...Huh, wha?! How'd you know?!
A-Are you psychic...?!
Here goes!! Pegasus—

I'm still just a rookie. Offering an opinion that could dictate
an Umamusume's entire racing career is, after all, terrifying.

Thanks!
Good luck in your mock race today too, Biko-chan!

However, Biko Pegasus seems intent on taking them head-on.
Just as I thought that might be too reckless—

I described Biko Pegasus's demeanor this morning and just now,
explaining why I concluded she might want to run on turf.

Showing not a hint of hesitation, she precisely spots an opening in the pack...
and slips right through with deft footwork.
Pegasus Mach... STRIKE!!

Ohh, really?! You've been saying you wanted
to run on turf for a while now! Congrats!

Where Biko Pegasus was pointing,
a mock race on the turf course was about to begin.

Back then, I kept spinning my wheels trying to get used to the job,
making an effort to come in early just to show dedication.
How's that?! I'm only getting started!!

That's awesome! Wait, you came to watch this morning too...?
Hehe, thanks for always cheering me on!!

*pant, pant*... I did it!!
Justice Biko... emerges victorious!!

No, I'm on the turf course starting today.
Mind if I use the lane next to yours?
...Well, yeah, it's true. I really do want to try running on turf.

! ...Heheh!
You're a suuuper... great person!
—Rapid Arrow!!

Aaahhh!! Thank you!!
Justice Biko will always be an ally of justice and everyone!

Biko Pegasus gazes enviously at the mock race.
Come to think of it, this morning as well—

Mornin'! ...Ah, sorry!
If you're using the track, hold on while I pack up!

An Umamusume who keeps training cheerfully every single day—Biko Pegasus.
Just watching her and gaining energy became my morning routine.
Yeah, I'll give it my all!! See ya later!

An Umamusume running on the grounds early every morning.
Rain or shine, there wasn't a single morning I didn't see her.

Practice, practice for the mock race!!
A hero is always moving forward, you seeee!!

Compared to them, smaller-framed Biko Pegasus would seem to need
to swing wide around the pack, even if it puts her at a distance disadvantage.

'Cause the very first hero I ever looked up to
was the coolest hero in the world, running across the green turf...

Courage in my heart, passion on the turf!!
Justice Biko has arrived!!

Apparently Biko Pegasus is running in a mock race today.
Since I'm here, I decided to watch her run all-out!

O-Of course, I'm not just saying that because it looks cool!
I completely understand why the instructor recommends dirt.

Is my judgment truly right? Can I take responsibility?
Until I'm prepared to step in—it's probably best to just observe.
Did you just say 'cool'?!

Seeing that dazzling run,
born clearly of tremendous hard work—

Just like an arrow—Biko Pegasus accelerated.
Short stride, rapid leg turnover... what they call a pitch running style.
However, that day was different—

The Umamusume in the mock race sprinted past right before my eyes.
Across the vivid green turf, like a single streak of light—

...Turf, huh... Wait, no, no, no!
What're you thinking, Justice Biko?!
All right, next is special move practice! Let's go!

Before Biko Pegasus's eyes stood a formidable leading pack,
formed by solidly built Umamusume.

I recall how Biko Pegasus ran.
The exceptional sharpness unleashed from her light footwork and speed...
Good morning, Biko-chan! Early as always!

That afternoon—the mock race featuring Biko Pegasus
got underway under clear blue skies.

Footwork made possible only by her petite build and powerful pitch stride,
and her courage—making full use of her strengths, Biko Pegasus claimed victory.

...Back then, Biko Pegasus was looking at the 'turf course.'
Which means—
Ah, the next race! Since you're here, let's watch together!!
